# One-Dimensional Man

*[Marcuse](../philosophers/marcuse.md) · 1964*

An essay by [Marcuse](../philosophers/marcuse.md) on advanced industrial society, which neutralizes all opposition by satisfying the needs it creates. It became one of the touchstone books of the 1968 protest movements.
